tasks.short: Read work orders and receive instructions for material-moving assignments.

steps.what: Read work orders for the assigned materials, locations and required equipment.
Receive oral instructions and clarify unusual material or equipment needs.
Determine the work assignment and confirm needed materials and equipment.

tasks.design: Test a native assignment view in {OPS_SYSTEM} with explicit material, destination and equipment fields. Retain supervisor clarification and local checks rather than asking a model to infer safe handling from incomplete instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Written work tickets can scatter the information needed for one assignment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order layouts can expose existing structured fields consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual loads and changing local conditions require direct clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that the stated equipment is unsuitable for the actual load or route.
tasks.altitude: Less instruction decoding; assignment and equipment authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Item identity, location and equipment-request fields.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clearer native work-order fields can reduce written-instruction decoding while retaining oral and physical clarification.

assumptions: Boundary is understanding an assignment before material movement; movement, equipment operation and supervisor planning are outside and unchanged.

Supervisor supplies order_id, revision, material_id, quantity, unit, source_location, destination and equipment_requirement. Missing or prose-only details retain manual reading and supervisor clarification; no model extraction is assumed.
Native layout configuration first. The 40/30/30 baseline is provisional and applies to mixed written and oral instruction work, not every assignment.
unknowns: Written versus oral instruction mix and structured field coverage.
research_questions: Can the revised view reduce written decoding without encouraging staff to skip clarification?

already_counted.description: Read and verify written assignment facts.

incremental.description: Report missing assignment fields or misleading equipment references.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=84 gross=16 net=15 after 1 upkeep. Low: mostly oral or already clear instructions; high: structured written orders with scattered fields. Oral clarification and local judgement unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sort cargo ahead of loading or unloading.

steps.what: Identify cargo destinations, handling categories and required sorting groups.
Physically sort cargo into the correct staging groups before loading or unloading.

tasks.design: Test native label lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM} to show a planned staging group after a cargo scan. The mover checks destination and handling restrictions, then sorts physically; damaged labels and unusual cargo return to manual identification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cargo labels may require repeated comparison with a separate loading plan.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing barcode references can connect labels to approved staging groups.
tasks.still_hard: Mixed or unstable cargo and restricted goods need physical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when the proposed group conflicts with actual cargo condition or safe staging.
tasks.altitude: Less label-to-plan lookup; loading and safety authority stay unchanged.

reach.task: Flag a staging-group conflict before loading begins.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: barcode-to-plan lookup can shorten identification, but does not perform physical cargo sorting.

assumptions: Boundary is identifying groups and physically sorting, excluding loading and transport. Only label lookup loses time; physical movement remains unchanged.

Planner supplies cargo_id, destination, staging_group, plan_revision and handling_category; shipper supplies barcode identity. Missing labels or plan conflicts require manual identification and supervisor clarification.
Native lookup first. Remaining identification time includes the new scan handling and review, so scanning is not assumed free. Access and national employee consultation are included where applicable.
unknowns: Barcode coverage and reliability of staging assignments.
research_questions: Does scanned lookup reduce sorting-group mistakes without hiding handling restrictions?

already_counted.description: Scan labels and verify the proposed group.

incremental.description: Resolve unreadable labels and report group-mapping defects.
Maintain staging mappings and scanner access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=91 gross=9 net=7 after 2 upkeep. Low: poor barcode coverage or already clear labels; high: repeated plan lookup. All physical sorting remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record unit counts on production sheets or work tickets.

steps.what: Establish the numbers of units handled or moved for the work ticket.
Record unit counts and movement details on daily production sheets or work tickets.
Check the completed ticket and clarify missing or conflicting unit counts.

tasks.design: Test native mobile work-ticket entry in {OPS_SYSTEM}, prefilled with assignment and material identifiers. Enter the actual count once and derive the daily sheet from those entries, while retaining count establishment and discrepancy checking.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper tickets and daily sheets can require repeated writing of the same identifiers and counts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse assignment fields and aggregate confirmed entries deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Mixed units, missed movements and uncertain physical counts cannot be repaired by aggregation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a genuine count from an estimate and explain corrections.

ambition.what: Resolve incomplete movement tickets before the end-of-shift handover.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated ticket entry; count-correction authority stays unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate a mismatch between a movement ticket and stock record.
reach.learn: Units, ticket identifiers and correction history.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct work-ticket entry can remove repeated transcription while physical count establishment stays manual.
The digest describes Dutch works-council consent requirements for scanner systems capable of monitoring staff; national rules elsewhere vary.

assumptions: Boundary is count establishment and recording, excluding the physical move itself and any later outbound-order log. Shared stock evidence must not be counted again as a separate recordkeeping saving.

Supervisor supplies ticket_id, assignment_id, material_id, unit and movement_type; mover supplies actual_count, observed_time and correction_reason. Missing identifiers or uncertain counts retain manual entry and supervisor clarification, not inferred quantities.

Test native forms first. Existing machine counters, if present, are system runtime and earn no human saving. Access, retention and national employee consultation are included; no worker ranking is proposed.
unknowns: Existing repeated entry and current count-verification practices.
research_questions: Can one confirmed ticket support daily totals without losing corrections or unit context?

already_counted.description: Review the direct-entry count and ticket fields.

incremental.description: Report form defects and resolve failed entry synchronization.
Maintain mobile forms, unit mappings and access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=85 gross=15 net=14 after 1 upkeep. Low: single-entry tickets already standard; high: paper and daily-sheet copying. Count establishment and final discrepancy checks unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce written instruction lookup and repeated counts entry while keeping physical handling and safety judgement intact.
role.ambitious_version: A material mover who catches unclear instructions and count conflicts before they spread into stock records.

job.title: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
